scope: Chinese-language primary-source audit of cadastral parcel data accessibility in Guangzhou, Shenzhen, and Chengdu. Metadata and service-contract evidence only; no parcel geometries, owner attributes, or sample parcel records persisted.

cities.name: Guangzhou
cities.assessment: Public cadastral-map lookup is officially documented. The four referenced land-right layers inspected are point geometry, and the tested query endpoint returned HTTP 500; no reusable polygon feed was verified.

sources.title: 广州不动产登记便利度改革政策一问一答（信息查询编、14条）
sources.publisher: 广州市规划和自然资源局
sources.finding: The official HTML confirms publication date 2025-05-27. It states any person may query cadastral maps by certificate number or spatial location; includes cadastral district/subdistrict and state/collective land-right information, and says the map is updated every half month. This is public lookup, not proof of bulk polygon download.

sources.title: 地籍图查询 (official interactive map)
sources.publisher: 广东省自然资源厅/天地图·广东, Guangzhou map
sources.finding: Map script lists four ArcGIS MapService layers for state construction land-use rights, collective land ownership, collective construction land-use rights, and land-right sources. All four layer metadata responses report esriGeometryPoint. A bounded and an unbounded query against the state land-right layer returned HTTP 500 with 查询图层信息失败. These are not parcel polygon features.

attempts.result: bounded and unbounded query requests both failed; no features returned

cities.boundary: No current evidence of a public polygon export or anonymously reusable parcel geometry service; absence of other unpublished services is not established.

cities.name: Shenzhen
cities.assessment: The official page documents a public cadastral viewer and its UI was inspected. Separately, the page-embedded public client flow exposed a nonempty bounded polygon feature query with native IDs and no identity input. This verifies technical sample access, not UI rendering or citywide completeness.

sources.title: 深圳市规划和自然资源局关于提供地籍图公众查询服务的通告
sources.publisher: 深圳市规划和自然资源局
sources.finding: Announces public cadastral-map query for Shenzhen excluding the Shenshan Cooperation Zone, including boundary, parcel code, area, use, and location. The notice describes a public viewing/query service, not an open-data download API.

sources.title: 地籍图查询 (current official viewer)
sources.publisher: 深圳市规划和自然资源局
sources.finding: Current page displays cadastral overview/legend and query fields for boundaries/codes/area/use/location. It presents an agreement stating personal information will be used for the query; it was left unchecked and no identity-bearing search/submission was performed. The UI identifies CRS CGCS2000 and imprint GS(2024)0568. This records the official page and inspected UI, not a claim that sample parcels rendered in the UI.

observedClientContract.clientBehavior: main.js sends X-OPENAPI-SubscriptionToken on ArcGIS requests. Its findFeature helper asks layer 0 for an envelope with where=1=1, returnGeometry=true and outFields='*'; its parcel lookup separately calls getBusinessData({q_no,p_parcel_no,p_parcel_code,op_type:1}), then filters by PARCEL_NO or PARCEL_CODE. The public page script contains the opaque token as a static obfuscated client literal; no token-issuance endpoint, login, captcha, or personal-identity input is part of this client flow. Token value was never logged or saved.
observedClientContract.authorizationBoundary: No personal identity was sent. The UI agreement was not accepted. The bounded map-layer query was sent using only the page’s public client flow and requested non-sensitive native parcel identifiers; whether the UI notice governs direct map-layer requests remains unresolved.
observedClientContract.credentialAcquisition: Static opaque token delivered in the anonymous page JavaScript; no separate issuance/acquisition call, account, login, captcha, or identity field observed. Token was decoded transiently in process memory only and never printed or persisted.

attempts.result: metadata request without page client header rejected
metadata request without page client header rejected
metadata request without page client header rejected

page-embedded public client header accepted; layer 土地权属 is esriGeometryPolygon, WKID 4547, maxRecordCount 1000, capabilities Map/Query/Data, supportsPagination=false. OBJECTID is esriFieldTypeOID although objectIdField and uniqueIdField metadata properties are null. Fields include PARCEL_CODE, PARCEL_NO and LOT_NO.

tiny approximately 0.001-degree bbox; only OBJECTID/PARCEL_CODE/PARCEL_NO/LOT_NO requested: 5 polygon features. For each field, sample nonblank=5, unique=5, duplicate=0. CountOnly=5 and returnIdsOnly=5 unique OIDs agreed. Exact OID read returned 5/5. Exact PARCEL_NO and LOT_NO filters each returned 5/5 input keys exactly once; exact PARCEL_CODE filter returned 6 features for 5 distinct sampled values (four values once, one twice), so PARCEL_CODE is not unique in this sample. No geometry was retained.

Supplying resultRecordCount caused ArcGIS error “Pagination is not supported” (HTTP status still 200); layer metadata confirms supportsPagination=false. This is not adapter-safe pagination or a citywide completeness proof.

cities.boundary: Verified bounded spatial query succeeds with only the static key distributed in the public page; no personal identity was sent. The sample establishes five nonempty polygon features with finite coordinates and closed rings, and exact OID/PARCEL_NO/LOT_NO reads return equivalent geometry. PARCEL_CODE duplicated in an exact sample query; PARCEL_NO and LOT_NO are one-to-one only within these five records. supportsPagination=false and a pagination error leave dense-cell/full-city completeness unproven; keep research-only pending an ID-first completeness proof.

request.resultRecordCount: omitted; explicit resultRecordCount is unsupported by this layer

exactReadGeometryComparison.normalization: canonical ring order/orientation and round coordinates to nine decimal places; comparison hashes calculated transiently only

cities.name: Chengdu
cities.assessment: Internal cadastral/registration database capability is supported by provincial official guidance, but no current Chengdu-specific public parcel polygon source was verified. The Chengdu public map inspected exposes planning/public-facility themes rather than a cadastral layer.

sources.title: 四川省不动产登记服务指南
sources.finding: Provincial service guidance states registration agencies maintain/update cadastral databases in linkage with real-property registration databases, and the register is organized by parcel. This establishes the official operational data model, not a citywide public endpoint or Chengdu-specific open layer.

sources.title: 成都市城市地图 (official city map)
sources.publisher: 成都市规划和自然资源局 (map portal)
sources.finding: Accessible public map lists civic facilities, boundaries, tourism, planning demonstrations, and construction-project themes; no cadastral parcel layer or parcel-query API was documented in the inspected UI.

sources.title: 四川省征地信息公开平台 (provincial natural-resources portal)
sources.finding: Lists Chengdu among municipal natural-resources links and public services such as land acquisition information and land-transfer announcements; these are administrative/planning/transaction records, not a cadastral boundary dataset.

attempts.result: DNS resolution failure from this environment; inconclusive

cities.boundary: Do not treat advertised land-sale/project plots as cadastral parcels: they describe planned or transacted development sites and do not establish current registered parcel boundaries. No anonymous native-ID sample request was possible against a verified Chengdu cadastral service.

reuseTerms: Terms/copyright statements were recorded as informational only; they were not used as a gate to technical integration. No reuse-license conclusion is made here.
